subject: Graduate Civil Engineer application, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi Walters Contracting team,

I'm applying for the Graduate Civil Engineer role advertised on SEEK.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines and completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia in February 2026, covering road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer, doing inspections, quality checks, crew coordination, materials tracking and progress reports. I'm based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, and have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027.

Your advert offers mentoring across planning, procurement, quality and site supervision with a pathway to Civil Project Manager, which is the start I'm looking for. I haven't worked on an Australian site yet, and I'm open to discussing relocation to northern Tasmania.

Could we arrange a short call? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.company_line: Walters Contracting is a family-owned civil construction, earthworks and quarrying business that has worked in the Deloraine area for over 50 years.
letter.subject: Application for Graduate Civil Engineer, Deloraine and northern Tasmania
paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate Civil Engineer role advertised on SEEK. Your advert offers hands-on training across project planning, procurement, quality and site supervision, with a pathway to Civil Project Manager, and that is the kind of start I want in civil construction.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi in the Philippines, and in February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia. That course covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, with drawings prepared in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As a project-in-charge engineer on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings and carried out inspections and quality checks. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials, prepared site and progress reports, and worked with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to sort out site issues.

I have not yet worked on an Australian construction site, so I would expect to learn your systems under supervision. I hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027, and I am open to discussing relocation to northern Tasmania.
Thank you for considering my application. I've attached my resume and cover letter, and my portfolio is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
